name: Stratholme Main Gate
summary: Ruined avenues beyond Stratholme Main Gate lead toward King’s Square and the Scarlet Bastion. The gate stands in the northwestern Eastern Plaguelands, at the entrance to Lordaeron’s northern metropolis.

sections.title: Gateway to a Fallen Jewel
sections.body: Stratholme was once northern Lordaeron’s pride and the birthplace of the Order of the Silver Hand. Its great arched gates now mark the edge of a nightmare begun during the Third War. Here, Prince Arthas turned against his mentor, Uther the Lightbringer. He purged his own citizens before the Plague of Undeath could claim them. The city has burned ever since and is now the region’s chief Scourge stronghold.

sections.title: The Scarlet Approach
sections.body: Beyond the main gate, the road passes through the ruins of King’s Square and Market Row toward the fortified Scarlet Bastion. Scarlet Crusade zealots entered here to reclaim the city and purge the dead, then made an encampment in the ruins. Overwhelming undead surround them. The crusaders fight an attrition war against the dark forces directing Stratholme’s defense, and they cannot win.

aliases: where does strat main gate go
faq.answer: The main gate opens into King’s Square and Market Row. From there, the route continues toward the Scarlet Bastion, where the Scarlet Crusade contests the district.

faq.q: Why is the city behind these gates still burning?
faq.answer: During the Third War, Prince Arthas purged the city and set it ablaze to stop the Plague of Undeath from spreading. Dark necromantic magic, unholy fires, and Scourge corruption have kept the ruins burning without pause ever since.

faq.q: What is the difference between this gate and the Service Entrance?
faq.answer: Both gates enter the same vast ruined city from opposite ends. The Main Gate opens near the city’s living and Scarlet-held quarters. The Service Entrance opens onto eastern streets beneath the Scourge slaughterhouses and Baron Rivendare’s rule.

faq.q: Who controls the area immediately inside the Main Gate?
aliases: what mobs are at strat front
faq.answer: Zombies, ghouls, skeletal horrors, and wandering shades prowl the first streets beyond the archway. Farther along the avenues, the Scarlet Crusade holds an embattled bastion.

angles.text: As a paladin, you may grieve at these gates. Here, on the day he purged Stratholme, Arthas disbanded the Silver Hand and fractured the order.
As a human, you pass beneath an archway that once marked the grand entrance to Lordaeron’s second-greatest capital. The city behind it is now an ash-choked necropolis.
